headline: Votes on Roux Institute Brownfields grant amendment, Job Creation Grant Program guidelines, grant applications, and loans for Garden Concerts, LLC (Portland House of Music), 25 Temple Street.
summary: The board will review a Brownfields grant amendment request from Roux Institute and vote on changes to the Job Creation Grant Program Guidelines. It will also vote on job creation grant applications, PDC Award Event nominations, and a commercial loan plus interest-free storefront loan for Garden Concerts, LLC (Portland House of Music), 25 Temple Street.
items: Review and vote on Brownfields grant amendment request from Roux Institute
Review and vote on recommendation to the City Council to re-amend the Job Creation Grant Program Guidelines
Review and discuss Delinquency Rates Relative to Loan Portfolio
Review and vote on updated recommendations for PDC Award Event Nominations
Review and vote on Job Creation Grant Program Applications: Calmbrook, 75 Bishop Street, Suite #19; Top Care, 400 Congress Street, Suite #318; Bad Neighbors, 511 Congress Street
Review and vote on Commercial Loan Application for $30,000 and an Interest-free Storefront Loan for $20,000 from Garden Concerts, LLC (Portland House of Music), 25 Temple Street
Treasurer's Report - October 2026, including Monthly Administrative Budget Report, Cash Management Report, Schedule of Loans Receivable, and Confidential Delinquency Report
Other Items to be discussed/brought up by Board Directors
